posts.title: Update ZED-X20P with Debian on piHAT
posts.description: Here I want to show you how to update a ZED-X20P without u-center2. This scenario is typically used if the X20P is mounted on a piHAT sitting on a Raspberry Pi running Linux like Debian. In my case, I’m use the pHAT from sparkfun.
